comment.body:
Thanks for reporting that the Store install is 0.102.3001. That is newer than the 0.96 handling linked above, so the installed version alone does not establish whether this is the old issue.

1. After fully quitting and relaunching PowerToys, what version does Settings/About show?
2. Please attach the exact error-dialog screenshot or copied error text. If it happens again, comment /bugreport and capture the diagnostic ZIP immediately afterward; if Settings/tray cannot open, use BugReportTool.exe in the installed PowerToys directory.

You do not need to force another black screen. These details will distinguish an old running process from a current failure without assuming PowerToys caused the DWM/LINE interruption.
